## Required

ROS 4.2.0 has 15 fields, 12 mandatory: trip/set identities, tori-line count, lighting and weighting details.

Hook-to-sinker distance, hook-pod use and four other-measure slots are also mandatory.

## Available

The 2025 review covers 67 trips (17 observer-monitored, 50 self-reporting) and 461 sets.

Snap weights are populated for 264 sets and swivel weights for 70. They describe components, not an average sinker.

No mitigation categories were selected. This does not prove that no mitigation was used.

## To decide

Establish actual counts, average weights, weighted-branchline percentages, distances, lighting and hook-pod use.

Whole-line length does not locate a sinker. Missing observations cannot justify zero or false responses.

Agree device correspondences and how to report fewer than four known measures.

The database allows an empty sheet without mitigation records. Reporting requirements remain open.
